Case 01 · Health / YMYL recovery

Recovering a 130,000-page medical platform after a multi-update drop

A large medical (YMYL) health platform of roughly 130,000 pages had lost visibility across several Google updates.

The situation

A large medical (YMYL) health platform of roughly 130,000 pages had lost visibility across several Google updates.

In a Your-Money-or-Your-Life niche, quality and trust signals are judged more strictly, so the recovery had to address the whole site rather than a handful of pages.

What I did

  1. 01

    Diagnosed the drop by update

    Traced the losses to specific Google core and spam updates instead of treating the decline as one event.

  2. 02

    Isolated scaled-content risk

    Identified about 20,000 duplicate pages that created scaled-content-abuse risk.

  3. 03

    Flagged infrastructure failures

    Surfaced host and crawl-budget failures that limited how much of the site Google could process.

  4. 04

    Built the recovery plan

    Action items across all pages, recovery of previously high-value URLs, and content gap and expansion analysis.

  5. 05

    Restructured the taxonomy

    Moved to a blog-to-category taxonomy and built a Pregnancy Questions Center as a structured topic hub.

  6. 06

    Audited rendering and prepared for AI search

    Ran Screaming Frog, Googlebot rendering, and Search Console audits, and prepared llms.txt for AI crawlers.

Recent update

A large-scale 301 consolidation was recently executed across a directory, part of a deliberate query-and-page consolidation strategy responding to today's zero-click SERP environment and protecting the site's threshold value. It produced a minor, expected dip that is already recovering.

Before & After Technical Architecture

BEFORE Scaled Duplicate URLs & Risk
  • 20,000 duplicate URLs creating scaled-content-abuse risk across core updates
  • Fragmented query targeting causing internal keyword cannibalization
  • Crawl budget waste on untracked zero-click parameter pages
AFTER Topic Hubs & Consolidation
  • Consolidated blog-to-category taxonomy & Pregnancy Questions Center hub
  • 301 directory consolidation protecting overall domain threshold value
  • Machine-readable llms.txt & schema grounding for AI search readiness
